notes: A quick fix release. The legend in the Content Flow and Treemap diagrams now opens in front of the visualization instead of being clipped away at the edge of the toolbar, so you can actually read what the colors mean. And in Content Flow, the toolbar buttons no longer stop responding after you switch the left column between current section and source site — Legend, Fit and the export buttons were being re-registered on every switch, so a second click undid the first and the legend appeared to do nothing at all.
